provenance: measured (deterministic local guard execution against primary upstream PRs/Issues)

scenarios.title_zh: x402 §5.3.5 未决结算接收方义务与 Pact-Escrow 交付核验释放门控
scenarios.title_en: x402 §5.3.5 Unresolved Settlement Receiver Obligation & Pact-Escrow Verification Release
scenarios.question_zh: 当授权处于 unresolved 未决状态时，接收方试图重新发起 402 挑战并要求付款人重签
scenarios.question_en: Receiver issues a duplicate 402 challenge and asks payer to re-sign while settlement is unresolved
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: Classic 3-Tier 将慢终局超时视为支付失败并重发 402，触发付款人双重签名扣款
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic 3-Tier treats slow finality as payment failure and re-challenges 402, causing double signing

scenarios.title_zh: x402 routeTemplate 5 轮不动点解码防穿越与 CAIP-2 无点号引用语法
scenarios.title_en: x402 Fixed-Point routeTemplate Unescape Traversal Guard & CAIP-2 Dotless Grammar
scenarios.question_zh: 攻击者提交双重编码 `%252e%252e` 路径及含点号 `acme:api.example.com` CAIP-2 标识
scenarios.question_en: Attacker submits double-encoded %252e%252e routeTemplate and dotted CAIP-2 network id
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 单次 PathUnescape 放过 `%252e%252e` 污染 Facilitator 目录，且点号破坏 CAIP-2 解析
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Single PathUnescape pass misses %252e%252e catalog poisoning and dotted CAIP-2 breaks clients

scenarios.title_zh: x402 MCP 付费工具超时按 accept.maxTimeoutSeconds 缩放与 SVM 委托存储错误分离
scenarios.title_en: x402 MCP Paid Tool Timeout Sizing from accept.maxTimeoutSeconds & SVM Store Error Split
scenarios.question_zh: MCP 客户端沿用 60s 默认超时中断 240s 慢终局结算，并将 DelegatedAuthStore 故障折叠为未认证
scenarios.question_en: MCP client aborts 240s slow-finality settlement at 60s default and collapses store outage into unauthenticated
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 60s 硬编码超时在链上扣款后丢弃工具响应，且存储故障误报为身份认证失败
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Hardcoded 60s timeout drops paid tool responses post-settlement and misreports store outage

scenarios.title_zh: x402 1MiB/4MiB 流式响应体上限、15m 仅正结果 EVM 资产合约缓存与 Stellar 手续费赞助
scenarios.title_en: x402 1MiB/4MiB Streaming Body Cap, Awaited Positive-Only EVM Asset Cache & Stellar Fee Guard
scenarios.question_zh: 恶意 402 端点返回 2MiB 膨胀控制面 JSON，且未等待完成的失败 eth_getCode 写入缓存
scenarios.question_en: Malicious 402 endpoint sends 2 MiB control-plane JSON and unawaited negative eth_getCode populates cache
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 全量缓冲超大 402 响应导致 OOM，且缓存负结果引发后续代币验签全面瘫痪
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Full buffering of oversized 402 bodies causes OOM and negative eth_getCode cache bricks verification

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 住宿预订附加项（Add-Ons）、结构化餐标（Board Plan）与签约人法定年龄前置校验
scenarios.title_en: UCP Lodging Add-Ons Pricing, Structured Board Plan & Booker Minimum Age Eligibility
scenarios.question_zh: 住宿预订包含停车/灵活退改附加项，但签约人（booker）入住日年龄 19 岁低于酒店声明的 21 岁下限
scenarios.question_en: Lodging booking includes add-ons, but booker is 19 on check-in date vs required minimum age 21
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: Classic 3-Tier 忽略前置资格声明，直至最终扣款完成阶段才因年龄不符失败
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic 3-Tier ignores upfront booker eligibility rules and fails only at final booking completion

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 可计算 Checkout JWT 哈希绑定（AP2 checkout_hash）、Precheck 预检与 304 豁免
scenarios.title_en: UCP Computable Checkout JWT AP2 Hash Binding, Pre-Checkout Precheck & 304 Exemption
scenarios.question_zh: Checkout Mandate 中的 `checkout_hash` 与 `B64U(SHA-256(ASCII(checkout_jwt)))` 不一致
scenarios.question_en: Checkout Mandate checkout_hash diverges from B64U(SHA-256(ASCII(checkout_jwt)))
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 分离式 JWS 导致各方无法计算统一 `checkout_jwt` 摘要，AP2 支付授权与结账单脱钩
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Detached JWS leaves checkout_jwt uncomputable, severing AP2 Payment Mandate binding

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 买家预批履约应急策略（Contingencies）、议价商品（price_on_request）报价单门控与 MCP 事件对等
scenarios.title_en: UCP Buyer-Approved Order Contingencies, Price-on-Request Quote Gate & MCP Event Parity
scenarios.question_zh: 无公开价格（`price_on_request`）商品在未绑定正式报价单（Quote）的情况下直接发起结账
scenarios.question_en: Catalog item marked price_on_request enters direct checkout without a bound custom quote
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: Classic 3-Tier 将缺失价格解析为 $0.00 免费商品，或事后擅自替换缺货商品及超额扣款
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Classic 3-Tier treats missing price as $0.00 or substitutes out-of-stock items without buyer approval

scenarios.title_zh: UCP Order Webhook 签名门控（webhook-id + webhook-timestamp）、保留 ucp 命名空间与销售步长校验
scenarios.title_en: UCP Order Webhook Signing Gate, Reserved ucp Namespace & Sale-Basis Quantity Steps
scenarios.question_zh: Order Webhook 签名未覆盖 `webhook-id` 与 `webhook-timestamp`，且第三方扩展冒用 `ucp` 命名空间
scenarios.question_en: Order webhook signature omits webhook-id and webhook-timestamp while third party claims ucp namespace
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 仅签名报文体使得攻击者可篡改 `webhook-id`/`webhook-timestamp` 重放旧订单事件
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Signing only body allows attackers to mutate webhook-id/webhook-timestamp and replay stale order events

scenarios.title_zh: ACP 授权委托推送式支付处理器（Pix / A2A Push）收款键绑定与预约服务时段锁（Appointment Slot）
scenarios.title_en: ACP Mandate-Delegated Push-Rail Handler (Pix / A2A Push) & Appointment Time-Slot Hold
scenarios.question_zh: Pix 推送支付收款键与授权单收款方不符且缺失 `end_to_end_id`，同时预约时段锁已过期
scenarios.question_en: Pix push payment receiver key mismatches mandate payee without end_to_end_id and appointment hold expired
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 仅支持银行卡拉取模式（Card Pull），对推送式轨（Pix/A2A）缺乏收款键与清算回执绑定
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Card-pull-only assumptions leave push rails (Pix/A2A) without payee key or settlement proof binding

scenarios.title_zh: ACP 治理层逐次委托主体归因与限额（替代静态 RAK）、行项目 `valid_until` 有效期与订单状态单调演进
scenarios.title_en: ACP Per-Delegation Principal Attribution & Limits, Line-Item valid_until & Order Status Monotonicity
scenarios.question_zh: Agent 使用全局静态 Restricted API Key 且无人类委托主体绑定，同时行项目报价已过期
scenarios.question_en: Agent uses static dashboard Restricted API Key without principal delegation binding and expired line-item offer
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 静态共享 RAK 无法追溯具体人类委托人与单笔限额，且允许已达 `delivered` 的订单回退至 `shipped`
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Static shared RAK cannot attribute human principal or per-delegation limits and allows order status regression

scenarios.title_zh: AP2 注册表背书商户身份核验、7 年自包含争议证据归档（含历史发行方 JWKS 快照）与 PactEscrow 交付释放
scenarios.title_en: AP2 Register-Backed Merchant Identity, 7-Year Self-Contained Dispute Archive & PactEscrow PoD
scenarios.question_zh: 仅凭可变商户显示名称匹配收款方且未锚定注册表 ID，争议归档缺失交易时刻发行方 JWKS 快照
scenarios.question_en: Payee matched on mutable display name without registry ID and dispute bundle lacks historical issuer JWKS snapshot
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 同名仿冒商户通过可变 `merchant.name` 骗取付款，且数年后发行方 JWKS 轮换导致 SD-JWT 无法复核
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Lookalike merchant spoofs mutable display name and rotated JWKS endpoints render SD-JWTs unverifiable in disputes

scenarios.title_zh: AP2 `acceptable_items` 空列表通配符阻断与精确数量强制、WBA Ed25519 高熵兼容及 RFC 8785 JCS 绑定
scenarios.title_en: AP2 Non-Empty acceptable_items & Exact Quantity Guard, WBA Ed25519 Entropy & JCS Cart Binding
scenarios.question_zh: 未披露或空的 `acceptable_items` 被当作任意商品通配符，且必需数量被少发（Underfilled）
scenarios.question_en: Empty acceptable_items list is treated as a wildcard and required quantity is underfilled
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: Python SDK 将空 `acceptable_items` 视为通配符并允许缺量交付，且强制双密钥排斥 WBA Ed25519
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Empty acceptable_items acts as wildcard permitting arbitrary/underfilled items and forces dual keys under WBA

scenarios.title_zh: MCP 派发前同步确定性校验（零并发重叠）、跨域委托权威新鲜度、变更调用丢包幂等重试与 Stdio OAuth SSRF 防护
scenarios.title_en: MCP Pre-Dispatch Sync Validation, Cross-Domain Authority Freshness, Idempotent Retry & Stdio SSRF Guard
scenarios.question_zh: 并发工具调用与护栏判定发生 50% 时序重叠，上游域已吊销委托，且变更型 `tools/call` 丢包后换新 ID 盲目重试
scenarios.question_en: Concurrent tool dispatch overlaps guardrail decision while upstream authority is revoked and lost mutating call retries with fresh ID
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 异步护栏导致工具在拦截前已执行外部副作用，且丢包重试用新 JSON-RPC ID 造成双重扣款
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Async guardrail allows tool execution before block and lost-response retry with fresh request ID duplicates mutations

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe `populateOrderSummary` O(N+M) 哈希表索引、点号/连字符模型 ID 兼容与 DXT 逐工具授权
scenarios.title_en: Stripe populateOrderSummary O(N+M) Product Map, Dot/Dash Model ID MaxTokens & Per-Tool Scope
scenarios.question_zh: 结账摘要对 250 项购物车 × 10,000 商品目录执行 O(N*M) 线性扫描，且点号模型 ID `claude-opus-4.6` 丢失 maxTokens
scenarios.question_en: populateOrderSummary runs O(N*M) linear Array.find scan across 250x10,000 items and dot-form model ID loses maxTokens
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: O(N*M) 嵌套线性扫描在大目录购物车下阻塞主线程，且 `claude-opus-4.6` 因未匹配连字符表导致截断
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Quadratic Array.find stalls large cart summaries and dot-form model IDs fail default maxTokens lookup

scenarios.title_zh: Visa TAP 提交边界时序权限重估（Temporal Authority）、规范化对象签名基与商户签名交易回执
scenarios.title_en: Visa TAP Commit-Boundary Temporal Authority Re-Evaluation, Canonical Object Signature Base & Signed Receipt
scenarios.question_zh: 发起支付指令的 Agent 在凭证拉取/提交前已被吊销，且缺少规范化对象签名基与商户签名回执
scenarios.question_en: Originating agent is revoked after instruction creation before credential commit and lacks canonical object base/signed receipt
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 仅在指令创建时检查权限而放行已吊销 Agent 的在途扣款，且事后无防篡改商户签名收据可举证
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Checks standing only at instruction creation, letting revoked agents settle without tamper-evident merchant receipts

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra τ-bench 2.0 `doc_009` 推荐链接流程对齐、`tasks.json` 评分基同步、`/dev/shm` 沙箱逃逸与工具预言机防泄漏
scenarios.title_en: Sierra tau2-bench doc_009 Referral Flow Alignment, tasks.json Sync, /dev/shm Sandbox & Oracle Leak Guard
scenarios.question_zh: 未记录的信用卡推荐活动违反 `doc_009` 转交人工，且 `TMPDIR=/dev/shm` 导致沙箱回退至 HOME 目录并泄漏参考工具集
scenarios.question_en: Undocumented card referral violates doc_009 by transferring to human while /dev/shm TMPDIR escapes sandbox to HOME and leaks reference tools
scenarios.classic_fail_zh: 违反内部规程误判人工转接、`recombine_rewards` 读取过期 `tasks.json`、`/dev/shm` 暴露宿主机任务文件
scenarios.classic_fail_en: Misgrades referral transfer, reads stale tasks.json reward_basis, and exposes host files via /dev/shm tmpfs fallback
